aggregation.depmap_rpe1: coordinatewise median of ACH-002462 through ACH-002467

axis_name: panel-mean basal transcriptomic distance for an official zero-shot held-out cell line
confirmation_set: All official ST-SE-Replogle zeroshot best-checkpoint rows are primary confirmation because the hypothesis is externally predeclared. ST-HVG-Replogle zeroshot best-checkpoint rows are a frozen representation/checkpoint replication on the same task; HPA is independent prospective-axis replication.
controls: true perturbation effect magnitude: real-LFC L2 norm divided by sqrt(number of genes)
number of real significant DE genes at FDR<0.05 when available
real and predicted cell counts per condition and control, acquired from official AnnData metadata
genetic perturbation identity as paired block
dose/time (fixed by source protocol; day 7 for Nadig screens and source-defined Replogle screens)
checkpoint selection (official best checkpoint primary; last checkpoint sensitivity)
atlas identity mapping including Jurkat E6.1 sensitivity and RPE1-clone aggregation sensitivity
deduplication: one row per normalized context and perturbation; duplicate gene symbols collapsed by arithmetic mean within DE table; duplicated perturbation rows rejected
direction: larger distance (lower similarity to nearest training context) predicts lower STATE performance
distance_metric: arithmetic mean over the three training contexts of one minus Spearman rank correlation across the frozen common-gene set
error_spending_plan: If the powered primary test is directionally consistent but inconclusive, one additional look is allowed only after predeclaring a fresh external-context increment. Use O'Brien-Fleming two-look one-sided boundaries alpha1=0.0056 and cumulative alpha2=0.05; do not repeatedly inspect the same four-context panel.

fixed_reference.availability: the other-three-context outcomes are training-panel observations available to the corresponding zero-shot STATE checkpoint
fixed_reference.definition: for each held-out context and perturbation, predict its real LFC vector as the arithmetic mean of the same perturbation's real LFC vectors in the other three contexts
fixed_reference.matching: score on the identical held-out context, perturbation, common genes, and signed Spearman metric as STATE; never consumes held-out outcome except for evaluation
fixed_reference.name: transfer-the-training-context mean

gene_set: all unique HGNC-style protein-coding gene symbols present in both DepMap 24Q4 protein-coding TPM logp1 and HPA cell-line RNA tables; lexical order; no target-derived filtering
hypothesis_source: user-prioritized predeclared axis; no STATE target outcomes inspected
inclusion_exclusion: official zeroshot/best-checkpoint per-perturbation tables; exclude non-targeting control; primary balanced panel is perturbations present in all four real and predicted tables with complete finite LFC metric; no outcome-based subgrouping
level_rule: four fixed levels L1-L4 are contexts sorted by increasing primary DepMap distance; lexical context breaks exact ties; HPA ordering is replication only and cannot change levels

metric.primary: signed Spearman correlation across all common finite genes between predicted and real log2 fold-change vectors; Fisher-z used for regression, raw rho reported
secondary: DE signed-LFC Spearman on significant genes

normalization.rank_transform: average ranks within each cell-line vector before Pearson correlation

power_plan: Use every complete balanced perturbation up to the official shared-data ceiling in one look. Primary inference resamples perturbation blocks, retaining all four contexts. No target peeking before this contract is frozen.

prospective_features.training_panel_rule: for each official leave-one-cell-line-out STATE checkpoint, the other three contexts are the training panel

prospective_validation.failed_predecessor: A1a nearest-context aggregation produced two unique symmetric distances and was rejected before scoring

sample_size_target.ceiling: all complete perturbations shared by the four official zero-shot contexts; if fewer than 263, use all and label underpowered rather than outcome-selecting
sample_size_target.derivation: paired standardized effect d=0.20, two-sided alpha 0.05, 90% power: ceil(((1.959964+1.281552)/0.20)^2)=263

success_criteria.atlas_replication: report Spearman correlation of the four DepMap and HPA distances, exact ordering agreement, and E6.1 sensitivity; disagreement is a stability limitation, not an outcome-informed axis rewrite
success_criteria.axis_validity: at least three unique, nontrivial DepMap panel-mean distances in fixed increasing order; report pairwise values and HPA rank replication without changing order
success_criteria.context_robustness: leave-one-perturbation-family diagnostics and exact permutation of four context labels are reported; claim scope is limited to the four official contexts
success_criteria.reference_gate: retain a real STATE degradation regardless of reference; call STATE degradation larger if slope difference STATE-reference CI is below -0.02, comparable/shared if its estimate and 95% CI intersect the [-0.02,0.02] ROPE, and smaller if above +0.02
success_criteria.target_degradation: predeclared distance coefficient on Fisher-z performance is negative, perturbation-block bootstrap 95% CI excludes zero, and farthest-minus-nearest raw-rho contrast is negative

unit: held-out cell-line x shared genetic perturbation; context is the independent axis level and perturbation is the paired block
